name: Embraer E190/E195
summary: Embraer's larger E-Jet regional airliners, flown in the US by airlines like JetBlue, with a few Lineage 1000 business conversions.

wings: Low swept wing with canted winglets
engines: Two CF34-10E turbofans slung under the wings
tail: Conventional tail with a tall swept fin and low-set stabilizer

tellTales: Regional jet with underwing engines and small winglets
Long, slender fuselage with a conventional low-set tail
Larger and longer than the E175

confusedWith.howToTell: The E175 is shorter with smaller engines; the E190/E195 is longer with a larger wing.
The A220 is wider-bodied with large engines on pylons and tall winglets; the E190 is a smaller, narrower regional jet.
The CRJ700/900 has rear-mounted engines and a T-tail; the E190 has underwing engines and a conventional tail.
The A320 is larger with a wider fuselage; the E190 is a smaller regional jet.
